definition: Initialize (r0,r1)=(a,b), (s0,s1)=(1,0), (t0,t1)=(0,1). While r1>0 set q=floor(r0/r1); replace each pair (u0,u1) by (u1,u0−q u1). At termination r0=gcd(a,b)=a s0+b t0.

name: Segmented Eratosthenes prime sieve
definition: For each integer block [L,R] within [2,N], mark initially true; for each base prime p≤sqrt(R), clear indices beginning at m=max(p²,p ceil(L/p)) and increment by p until m>R.
variables: N inclusive upper bound; L,R block endpoints; p base prime; m multiple
assumptions: Exact bounded integer arithmetic, complete base primes to floor(sqrt(N)), disjoint blocks covering [2,N]
limitations: Provisional storage and block-overhead analysis pending
failure_conditions: Invalid block size, incomplete base primes or overflow.
